text:
jenny: Quick design sync — hit from the accessibility audit on the roles matrix + invite flow. Two main things: (1) screen-reader announcements when you expand a role row, and (2) the SSO toggle copy feels ambiguous. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/roles-matrix sam: Reproduced the SR issue — when you expand a row the reader says only 'row expanded' and loses the role name. That makes it hard to know which role opened. Suggest adding an aria-live message that includes the role name, e.g. 'Role: Billing Admin expanded'. :eyes: maria: Also noticed the chevron tap target is tiny on mobile. Contrast report flags the chevron color against the white row (fails 3:1). Proposal: increase hit target to 44x44 and use #0f172a for the icon so it passes. I'll drop a quick spec in the figma. aj: For the invite flow, bulk-invite fails are currently a single toast 'Some invites failed' and disappears. Need persistent feedback: '2 invites failed — View errors' with a modal listing emails + copyable error reasons and a 'Retry failed' button. This will reduce support tickets. jenny: +1. Also copy nit for SSO toggle: current label 'Enforce SSO' reads terse/unclear. Options thrown around: 'Require Single Sign-On (SSO) for sign-in', 'Require SSO for org access', or longer helper text under the toggle that explains what changes (blocks password logins, affects invites). sam: I lean toward 'Require Single Sign-On (SSO) to sign in' — consistent with other places where we use 'sign in' phrasing. Also add a subtle inline help link 'What does this mean?' that opens the enterprise docs. accessibility-bot: Automated a11y scan completed for /console/roles-matrix. Results: 4 failures, 7 warnings. See report: https://a11y-reports.internal/17645 maria: One more thing — keyboard focus order is odd when a role detail panel expands. Focus stays on the expand button; recommend shifting focus to the first control inside the panel and adding a visible focus ring. That improves discoverability for keyboard users. aj: UX question: if we move focus into the panel, we need an escape/focus-back behavior. Propose ESC returns focus to chevron, and include 'Close' button first in the panel header. sam: Suggested ARIA snippet for the expanded panel: ```

Billing Admin

``` This pairs the announce with the visible header. jenny: Love it. Small visual polish: make the role chips use token spacing 8/12, not 6/8 — chips feel cramped when you have 3-4 roles. Also ensure the role color tokens meet contrast. accessibility-bot: Quick reminder: when updating text in toggles, run another scan. Changing copy can affect line-wrapping which impacts contrast in some layouts. :memo: maria: I'll mock the changes (chevron hit target, focus behavior, revised chip spacing) and post frames by EOD. @sam can you apply the aria-live snippet to the prototype? sam: Yep — will wire it up and smoke-test with VoiceOver and NVDA. Will post short test notes once done. :thumbsup: jenny: Thanks team — we'll review the updated frames in tomorrow's design crit. If anyone sees edge cases for invites (SAML user provisioning, invited user with existing SSO), flag here and we'll add to the spec.
